source.author: verg
source.text: ipsi per medias acies insignibus alis ingentes animos angusto in pectore versant, usque adeo obnixi non cedere, dum gravis aut hos aut hos versa fuga victor dare terga subegit.
source.text_original: ipsi per medias acies insignibus alis / ingentes animos angusto in pectore versant, / usque adeo obnixi non cedere, dum gravis aut hos / aut hos versa fuga victor dare terga subegit.
source.text_english: They themselves, with their conspicuous wings, amid the ranks, revolve mighty spirits in a narrow breast, so resolutely determined not to yield, until the heavy rout, now turned this way, now that, has forced the victor to turn his back.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: o si uideres sororem tuam et illud sacri oris eloquium coram audire contingeret, cerneres in paruo corpusculo ingentes animos, audires totam ueteris et noui testamenti supellectilem ex illius corde feruere.
reuse.text_original: o si uideres sororem tuam et illud sacri oris eloquium coram audire contingeret, cerneres in paruo corpusculo ingentes animos, audires totam ueteris et noui testamenti supellectilem ex illius corde feruere.
reuse.text_english: O if you could see your sister and if it were your lot to hear in person that speech from her sacred mouth, you would behold in that small little body a great soul, and you would hear the whole storehouse of the Old and New Testament seething forth from her heart.
